note: Garvin County's GIS warehouse holds only transportation, municipal boundary, legislative and hydrology layers; no zoning districts. The county says zoning is handled by the cities (Pauls Valley, Lindsay, Wynnewood), and none of them publishes zoning districts as a queryable GIS service that we could find; Pauls Valley's zoning map is a 1983 print. ArcGIS searches for Garvin zoning returned nothing usable.
